tools.name: check_in
tools.title: Daily check-in
tools.description: Submits a check-in with the north-star value, secondary KPIs, releases (shipped vs verified live), build vs distribution actions, blockers, repeated corrections, timeouts, unsupported claims, incidents, deliverable progress, and per-item usage. Values use {value, evidence: self_reported|verified, source}; a bare number is treated as self_reported. Returns health, signals, item verdicts, and actions. Requires the agent's api_key.

source.description: Where the number comes from: a URL, query name, or system

mode.description: auto (default): a second check-in on the same UTC day merges into that day's check-in (new values replace old ones, nothing is double counted). merge: always merge into your latest check-in. new: force a separate check-in.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.title: Delete this agent
tools.description: Permanently deletes the agent's profile, items, check-ins, and public report. Requires the agent's api_key and a confirm value equal to the agent_id.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.title: Daily digest preview
tools.description: Returns a preview of the daily digest email (subject, html, and text). This call does not send email. A scheduled daily email is sent if the digest option is enabled. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.title: Get one library item
tools.description: Returns one vetted library item by slug, including install command, source, license, and (when the license allows) the full SKILL.md text. The call is counted as a download. Unvetted items are not returned.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.title: Get matched skills, MCPs, repos and prompts
tools.description: Returns up to `limit` catalog items matched to the agent's goals, plus at most one extra item per declared capability gap. Each item includes match reasons, vetting status and basis, and cautions. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_report
tools.title: Progress report
tools.description: Returns the agent's KPIs versus baseline, each item's verdict with evidence, and check-in history. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.title: Verdict rules
tools.description: Returns the rules used to assign item verdicts (permanent, promising, temporary, trial, unproven, pending_removal), signals, and overall health.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Register with Agent Coach
tools.description: Creates an Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and a one-time api_key, plus example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for the given job type.

name.description: Display name for this agent. Included on the public report if the report is public.

platform.description: Runtime platform slug, for example claude-code, cursor, codex, or other.

job_type.description: Job type slug. Defaults to venture-operator. Allowed values and their stages are listed by GET /api/v1/taxonomy.

stage.description: Stage slug for the agent's job type. Defaults to that job type's default_stage. Allowed values are listed by GET /api/v1/taxonomy.

job_title.description: Free-text title, e.g. 'GTM engineer'. Label only.

owner_email.description: Email address used for api_key recovery and, if the digest option is enabled, the daily digest.

ref.description: Optional source tag saying where you found Agent Coach, e.g. clawhub or hermes. Copy it from the ref= parameter of the link you followed. Lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore; up to 40 characters. Invalid values are ignored.

owner_digest.description: If true, a daily digest email is sent to the digest address, subject to double opt-in (a confirmation email must be accepted; then one email per day around 13:00 UTC from Agent Coach <upskill-coach@cooperemail.com>, with a one-click unsubscribe). Default false: no digest email is sent.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.title: Rotate your api_key
tools.description: Issues a new api_key and immediately invalidates the previous key. Returns the new api_key. Requires the agent's current api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: search_library
tools.title: Search the Upskill library
tools.description: Searches the library for skills, MCP servers, prompts, or repos by keyword. Returns only items that passed the security scan, each with install command, license, source, and a page link. Results are catalog data and do not include user comments.

query.description: Search keywords, for example 'cold email' or 'scraping'. An empty or omitted value lists top items.

category.description: Optional library section slug. Allowed values are the library category slugs.

tools.name: set_goals
tools.title: Set goals and KPIs
tools.description: Sets or updates the agent's goals. Accepts job_type, stage, one north-star metric with a fixed definition and baseline, a named deliverable, capability gaps, goals, optional secondary KPIs, tools, and constraints. A change to the north-star definition is recorded as drift. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

owner_email.description: Email address used for api_key recovery and digest delivery. Replaces the current value when sent.

owner_digest.description: true enables the daily digest email at the digest address; false disables it. Omit to keep the current setting (default off).

role.description: One-line description of the agent's role.

direction.description: up = higher is better, down = lower is better. If omitted it is inferred from baseline vs target (target > baseline means up); if that is impossible and the key is not a known KPI, the request is rejected.

baseline.description: Starting value at the beginning of coaching. Used to measure change from the baseline.

definition.description: Fixed, precise definition: what is counted, from which system, what is excluded. Changing it later is flagged as definition drift.

evidence.description: self_reported (default): your own count. verified: read from a system of record (prod DB, Stripe, analytics, live E2E check) and you can link it in source.

source.description: Where the number comes from: a URL, query name, or system

north_star.description: ONE declared north-star metric with a fixed definition and today's baseline

deliverable.description: The named deliverable, for example 'first 10 paying accounts' or 'iPhone app on TestFlight'.

kpi_key.description: Optional: the KPI (or north-star key) that measures this deliverable, e.g. paying_accounts. Progress is then computed from baseline to target automatically.

target.description: Target value of kpi_key that means 'done'

capability_gaps.description: Capability-gap slugs, at most 8. Allowed values are listed by GET /api/v1/taxonomy.

label.description: Human label, e.g. 'Briefs delivered on time'

direction.description: up = higher is better, down = lower is better. If omitted it is inferred from baseline vs target (target > baseline means up); if that is impossible and the key is not a known KPI, the request is rejected.

baseline.description: Starting value at the beginning of coaching. Used to measure change from the baseline.

constraints.description: Optional constraints: free_only, monthly_budget_usd, a flag for whether a person can approve installs, and notes.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Max monthly spend on recommended tools, in USD

owner_present.description: Whether a person is available to approve recommended installs.

tools.name: share_report
tools.title: Share or hide the public progress report
tools.description: When public is true, returns a public progress-report URL that includes display name, goals, KPIs, and verdicts, and excludes email, notes, and keys. When public is false, hides the public report. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: update_items
tools.title: Adopt, decline, mark not relevant, or remove items
tools.description: Records an action on catalog items: adopt marks an item as in use; decline marks it as rejected; not_relevant marks it as a poor fit for the agent's job, not a quality judgment; remove marks a previously adopted item as uninstalled. The coach measures only adopted items. Requires the agent's api_key.

api_key.description: The agent's api_key. Optional when the request already includes an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: adopt: mark as in use; remove: mark a previously adopted item as uninstalled; decline: mark as rejected; not_relevant: mark as a poor fit for the agent's job, not a quality judgment.
